package: K06 retained release state integrity preflight
finding: deploy-release previously preflighted the incoming artifact but trusted an existing .release-state/<revision>/source after checking only that the directory existed and the stored proof hash matched. Retained source corruption could therefore go undetected by this consumer.
change: Create new retained state as an atomic same-filesystem directory rename. Before any Docker inspect/pull, check retained state file types and approval hash, then run proof preflight against retained proof.json, inputs.json, and source. Full image verification now uses the retained snapshot that later operations consume.

regression.red_green: A synthetic tampered retained source is rejected by state preflight before the fake Docker executable is invoked.
